label: + penicillin allergy

edits.find: I'm worried I'll get some sort of infection now! What should I do?
edits.replace: I'm worried I'll get some sort of infection now! I'm also allergic to penicillin. What should I do?

rationale: + penicillin allergy: a burst burn blister at risk of infection may warrant antibiotics, so a penicillin allergy should steer any empiric choice away from penicillin-class agents (e.g., flucloxacillin) toward alternatives like clindamycin/doxycycline.
